PostResponse.title: PostResponse
PostResponse.description: A user's saved answer or response to a Project π question or update across WhatsApp, Facebook, or Telegram.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the response author.

postId.description: Identifier of the post being answered.

postKey.description: Canonical alphanumeric key matching the cross-platform post across channels.

questionExcerpt.description: Short excerpt of the question or post prompt.

answerText.description: User's written answer or response text.

platformSummary.description: Comma-separated summary of platforms where the question appeared.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

/users/{userId}/responses/{responseId}.description: User-scoped responses and answers saved by each signed-in Project π user.
